relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of CAMKII, CAMKII mRNA, and P‐CREB was reduced in the spinal cord tissue of rats in the EA group compared with the CSR group (p < .01).

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with the CSR group, the expressions of BDNF, P‐TrkB protein and BDNF mRNA, and TrkB mRNA were decreased (p < .01)

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of c‐fos was reduced in the spinal cord tissues of rat spinal cord in the EA group compared with the CSR group (p < .05)

relationships.subject: Electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: NLGN2 expression was reduced in the spinal cord synaptic tissue of rats in the EA group compared with the CSR group (p < .05)

key_findings: EA raised pain thresholds in CSR rats and reduced spinal BDNF, P-TrkB, CaMKII, P-CREB, c-fos and NLGN2.
Results suggest EA analgesia involves inhibition of the CaMKII/CREB/BDNF pathway and spinal synaptic plasticity.
